```{r setup, include=FALSE}
project_dir <- normalizePath(params$project_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
local_library <- file.path(project_dir, "R_library")
.libPaths(c(local_library, .libPaths()))

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(iNEXT)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(knitr)
})

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 160
)

set.seed(27)
dir.create(file.path(project_dir, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(project_dir, "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

group_colours <- c(HEO = "#D55E00", HYC = "#0072B2")
q_labels <- c(`0` = "q = 0 (richness)", `1` = "q = 1 (Shannon diversity)", `2` = "q = 2 (Simpson diversity)")
```

# Scope

This report analyzes each biological sample separately. It does not pool reads or mOTU counts across samples. `N` and `C` are mapped to HEO, while `CO` is mapped to HYC. The abundance values are marker-based estimated insert counts from shotgun metagenomic reads; they are not ASVs, cellular counts, or absolute microbial abundances.

# Input validation

```{r read-and-validate}
profile_path <- file.path(project_dir, "motus_INSERT_RAW_71_samples.tsv")
manifest_path <- file.path(project_dir, "sample_manifest.tsv")

stopifnot(file.exists(profile_path), file.info(profile_path)$size > 0)
stopifnot(file.exists(manifest_path), file.info(manifest_path)$size > 0)

settings_line <- readLines(profile_path, n = 1L, warn = FALSE)
expected_settings <- paste(
  "#tool_version=4.1.0",
  "database_version=4.1",
  "min_alignment_length=75",
  "min_mgcs=3",
  "count_mode=INSERT_RAW",
  "value_type=counts",
  sep = "\t"
)
if (!identical(settings_line, expected_settings)) {
  stop("Unexpected mOTUs settings header: ", settings_line)
}

motus_table <- read_tsv(
  profile_path,
  skip = 1,
  col_types = cols(.default = col_double(), mOTU = col_character(), Taxonomy = col_character()),
  name_repair = "minimal",
  progress = FALSE
)
manifest <- read_tsv(manifest_path, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)

required_manifest <- c("sample_id", "original_group", "analysis_group", "subject_id", "age", "sex")
if (!all(required_manifest %in% names(manifest))) stop("Manifest is missing required metadata columns.")
if (nrow(manifest) != 71L || anyDuplicated(manifest$sample_id)) stop("Manifest must have 71 unique samples.")
if (!identical(sort(unique(manifest$original_group)), c("C", "CO", "N"))) stop("Unexpected original groups.")
if (!identical(sort(unique(manifest$analysis_group)), c("HEO", "HYC"))) stop("Unexpected analysis groups.")
if (sum(manifest$original_group == "N") != 14L ||
    sum(manifest$original_group == "C") != 7L ||
    sum(manifest$original_group == "CO") != 50L) stop("Unexpected metadata group counts.")
if (any(manifest$analysis_group != ifelse(manifest$original_group %in% c("N", "C"), "HEO", "HYC"))) {
  stop("N/C to HEO and CO to HYC mapping is inconsistent.")
}

if (!identical(names(motus_table)[1:2], c("mOTU", "Taxonomy"))) stop("Unexpected mOTUs annotation columns.")
sample_columns <- names(motus_table)[-(1:2)]
if (length(sample_columns) != 71L || anyDuplicated(sample_columns)) stop("Merged profile must contain 71 unique sample columns.")
if (!setequal(sample_columns, manifest$sample_id)) stop("Merged profile sample columns do not exactly match metadata.")
if (anyNA(motus_table$mOTU) || any(motus_table$mOTU == "") || anyDuplicated(motus_table$mOTU)) {
  stop("mOTU identifiers are missing, blank, or duplicated.")
}

count_matrix <- as.matrix(motus_table[, sample_columns])
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "double"
rownames(count_matrix) <- motus_table$mOTU
if (anyNA(count_matrix) || any(!is.finite(count_matrix))) stop("Count matrix contains missing or nonfinite values.")
if (any(count_matrix < 0)) stop("Count matrix contains negative values.")

aggregate_unassigned <- grepl("unassigned", motus_table$mOTU, ignore.case = TRUE)
if (sum(aggregate_unassigned) > 1L) stop("More than one aggregate unassigned row was detected.")
if (sum(aggregate_unassigned) == 0L) warning("No aggregate unassigned row was present in the merged table.")

retained_motus <- motus_table$mOTU[!aggregate_unassigned]
retained_taxonomy <- motus_table$Taxonomy[!aggregate_unassigned]
raw_counts <- count_matrix[!aggregate_unassigned, , drop = FALSE]
if (anyDuplicated(retained_motus)) stop("Duplicated retained mOTU identifiers detected.")

validation_summary <- tibble(
  item = c(
    "Biological samples",
    "HEO samples",
    "HYC samples",
    "Rows in merged profile",
    "Aggregate unassigned rows removed",
    "Retained mOTUs observed in at least one sample"
  ),
  value = c(
    length(sample_columns),
    sum(manifest$analysis_group == "HEO"),
    sum(manifest$analysis_group == "HYC"),
    nrow(motus_table),
    sum(aggregate_unassigned),
    sum(rowSums(raw_counts) > 0)
  )
)
kable(validation_summary)
```

Only the database's aggregate `unassigned` mOTU row is excluded. Taxonomically unclassified but valid mOTUs are retained.

# Nearest-integer conversion and rounding QC

mOTUs 4.1 serializes `INSERT_RAW` values as integers. The explicit nearest-integer conversion below is retained as a validation step and makes the iNEXT input requirement reproducible if the upstream serialization changes in a future version.

```{r rounding-qc}
rounded_counts <- round(raw_counts)
storage.mode(rounded_counts) <- "double"

if (any(rounded_counts < 0) || anyNA(rounded_counts) || any(!is.finite(rounded_counts))) {
  stop("Rounded matrix contains invalid values.")
}
if (any(abs(rounded_counts - floor(rounded_counts)) > .Machine$double.eps^0.5)) {
  stop("iNEXT input is not integer-valued after rounding.")
}
if (any(colSums(rounded_counts) <= 0)) {
  stop("At least one sample is all zero after removal of the aggregate unassigned row.")
}

rounding_qc <- tibble(
  sample_id = sample_columns,
  total_before_rounding = colSums(raw_counts),
  total_after_rounding = colSums(rounded_counts)
) |>
  mutate(
    count_difference = total_after_rounding - total_before_rounding,
    percent_change = if_else(
      total_before_rounding > 0,
      100 * count_difference / total_before_rounding,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(manifest |> select(all_of(required_manifest)), by = "sample_id")

if (nrow(rounding_qc) != 71L || anyNA(rounding_qc$analysis_group)) {
  stop("Rounding QC could not be matched exactly to metadata.")
}

write_tsv(rounding_qc, file.path(project_dir, "tables", "rounding_qc.tsv"))

rounding_plot_data <- rounding_qc |>
  arrange(analysis_group, percent_change, sample_id) |>
  mutate(sample_id = factor(sample_id, levels = sample_id))

p_rounding <- ggplot(rounding_plot_data, aes(x = sample_id, y = percent_change, fill = analysis_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.78) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1), colour = "#555555", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colours, name = "Group") +
  labs(
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Change in total marker-insert count after rounding (%)",
    title = "Per-sample effect of nearest-integer rounding"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave(file.path(project_dir, "figures", "rounding_qc_percent_change.png"), p_rounding,
       width = 13, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(project_dir, "figures", "rounding_qc_percent_change.pdf"), p_rounding,
       width = 13, height = 5.5)
p_rounding
```

```{r rounding-warning, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
exceeds_one_percent <- any(abs(rounding_qc$percent_change) > 1, na.rm = TRUE)
if (exceeds_one_percent) {
  cat("\n> **WARNING:** At least one sample changed by more than 1% after rounding. Inspect `tables/rounding_qc.tsv` before interpreting diversity estimates.\n")
} else {
  cat("\n> **Rounding QC passed:** No sample changed by more than 1% after rounding.\n")
}
```

# Per-sample iNEXT analysis

```{r run-inext}
abundance_list <- setNames(lapply(sample_columns, function(sample_id) {
  values <- rounded_counts[, sample_id]
  names(values) <- retained_motus
  values[values > 0]
}), sample_columns)

if (length(abundance_list) != 71L || any(vapply(abundance_list, length, integer(1)) == 0L)) {
  stop("Every sample must contain at least one positive retained mOTU.")
}
if (!all(vapply(abundance_list, function(x) all(x >= 0 & x == floor(x)), logical(1)))) {
  stop("All iNEXT abundance vectors must contain only nonnegative integers.")
}

set.seed(27)
inext_results <- lapply(seq_along(abundance_list), function(index) {
  sample_id <- names(abundance_list)[index]
  x <- abundance_list[[index]]
  message(sprintf("iNEXT sample %d/71: %s", index, sample_id))
  iNEXT(
    x,
    q = c(0, 1, 2),
    datatype = "abundance",
    endpoint = 2 * sum(x),
    knots = 40,
    se = TRUE,
    nboot = 100,
    conf = 0.95
  )
})
names(inext_results) <- names(abundance_list)
```

## Coverage and marker-insert depth

```{r data-info}
data_info <- bind_rows(lapply(names(inext_results), function(sample_id) {
  as_tibble(inext_results[[sample_id]]$DataInfo) |>
    mutate(sample_id = sample_id, .before = 1)
}))

if (!all(c("n", "S.obs", "SC") %in% names(data_info))) {
  stop("Unexpected iNEXT DataInfo columns.")
}

depth_coverage <- data_info |>
  select(sample_id, observed_marker_insert_depth = n, observed_motus = S.obs,
         observed_sample_coverage = SC, everything()) |>
  left_join(
    rounding_qc |>
      select(sample_id, original_group, analysis_group, subject_id, age, sex,
             total_before_rounding, total_after_rounding, percent_change),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) |>
  relocate(original_group, analysis_group, subject_id, age, sex, .after = sample_id)

if (nrow(depth_coverage) != 71L || anyNA(depth_coverage$analysis_group)) {
  stop("Coverage/depth table does not contain 71 metadata-matched samples.")
}
if (any(depth_coverage$observed_marker_insert_depth != depth_coverage$total_after_rounding)) {
  stop("iNEXT marker-insert depth does not equal the rounded input total.")
}

write_tsv(depth_coverage, file.path(project_dir, "tables", "sample_coverage_marker_insert_depth.tsv"))
kable(depth_coverage |> select(sample_id, original_group, analysis_group,
                               observed_marker_insert_depth, observed_motus,
                               observed_sample_coverage) |> head(15), digits = 4)
```

## Sample-size-based curves

```{r size-based-curves, fig.width=13, fig.height=7}
size_curves <- bind_rows(lapply(names(inext_results), function(sample_id) {
  as_tibble(inext_results[[sample_id]]$iNextEst$size_based) |>
    mutate(sample_id = sample_id, .before = 1)
})) |>
  left_join(manifest |> select(sample_id, analysis_group), by = "sample_id")

if (anyNA(size_curves$analysis_group)) stop("Size-based curves have unmatched samples.")
write_tsv(size_curves, file.path(project_dir, "tables", "inext_size_based_estimates.tsv"))

p_size <- ggplot(
  size_curves |> filter(Method != "Observed"),
  aes(x = m, y = qD, colour = analysis_group,
      group = interaction(sample_id, Method), linetype = Method)
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.34, linewidth = 0.38) +
  geom_point(
    data = size_curves |> filter(Method == "Observed"),
    mapping = aes(x = m, y = qD, colour = analysis_group, group = sample_id),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 0.9, alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Order.q, scales = "free_y", labeller = as_labeller(q_labels)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_colours, name = "Group") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Rarefaction = "solid", Extrapolation = "dashed")) +
  labs(
    x = "Marker-insert sample size",
    y = "Hill diversity",
    title = "Per-sample size-based rarefaction and extrapolation"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave(file.path(project_dir, "figures", "inext_size_based_curves.png"), p_size,
       width = 13, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(project_dir, "figures", "inext_size_based_curves.pdf"), p_size,
       width = 13, height = 7)
p_size
```

# Hill diversity at shared minimum observed coverage

```{r standardized-diversity}
target_coverage <- min(depth_coverage$observed_sample_coverage)
if (!is.finite(target_coverage) || target_coverage <= 0 || target_coverage > 1) {
  stop("Invalid shared target coverage: ", target_coverage)
}

set.seed(27)
standardized_diversity <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(abundance_list), function(index) {
  sample_id <- names(abundance_list)[index]
  message(sprintf("Coverage-standardized diversity %d/71: %s", index, sample_id))
  as_tibble(estimateD(
    abundance_list[[index]],
    q = c(0, 1, 2),
    datatype = "abundance",
    base = "coverage",
    level = target_coverage,
    nboot = 100,
    conf = 0.95
  )) |>
    mutate(sample_id = sample_id, .before = 1)
})) |>
  left_join(manifest |> select(sample_id, original_group, analysis_group, subject_id, age, sex),
            by = "sample_id") |>
  relocate(original_group, analysis_group, subject_id, age, sex, .after = sample_id)

if (nrow(standardized_diversity) != 71L * 3L || anyNA(standardized_diversity$analysis_group)) {
  stop("Expected three standardized Hill estimates for each of 71 samples.")
}
if (!all(c("Order.q", "qD", "qD.LCL", "qD.UCL") %in% names(standardized_diversity))) {
  stop("Unexpected estimateD output columns.")
}

write_tsv(
  standardized_diversity,
  file.path(project_dir, "tables", "hill_diversity_minimum_shared_coverage.tsv")
)

descriptive_summary <- standardized_diversity |>
  group_by(analysis_group, Order.q) |>
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    target_coverage = first(SC),
    mean_hill_diversity = mean(qD),
    sd_hill_diversity = sd(qD),
    median_hill_diversity = median(qD),
    q1_hill_diversity = quantile(qD, 0.25),
    q3_hill_diversity = quantile(qD, 0.75),
    min_hill_diversity = min(qD),
    max_hill_diversity = max(qD),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_tsv(
  descriptive_summary,
  file.path(project_dir, "tables", "hill_diversity_descriptive_HEO_HYC.tsv")
)

target_table <- tibble(
  standardization = "Minimum observed coverage shared by all 71 samples",
  coverage = target_coverage,
  seed = 27L,
  knots = 40L,
  bootstrap_replicates = 100L,
  confidence_level = 0.95
)
write_tsv(target_table, file.path(project_dir, "tables", "inext_analysis_settings.tsv"))

cat("Shared target coverage:", format(target_coverage, digits = 8), "\n\n")
kable(descriptive_summary, digits = 4)
```

These summaries describe the distributions of per-sample estimates in HEO and HYC. Counts were not summed across biological samples, and no pooled-sample diversity estimate was calculated.
